goal: Promote seven high-value MVNO/mobile services from carried-forward 2026-08-08 evidence to current exact 2026-09-23 MNP procedure records, while preserving the 72-service unified master and existing URLs.
key_results: IIJmio: current issue-time range, voice-only eligibility, no data/SMS MNP, reissue/expiry timing and one-stop behavior structured.
mineo: 24-hour request reception, 9:02-20:59 processing window, next-day sequential processing and next-day notification structured.
BIGLOBE Mobile: next-day notification, 15-day validity, reissue after expiry, active-number cancellation route and share-SIM ordering structured.
Japan Communications SIM: up-to-two-day issuance/one-stop processing, 15-day validity and identity-mismatch boundary structured.
HIS Mobile: current My HIS Mobile/USIM/email flow structured; stale unverified carrier-specific issue-time estimates removed from public static guidance.
NURO Mobile: 1-2 day issuance, no same-day issue, no extension/reissue before expiry, data+SMS exclusion and in-progress-procedure blockers structured.
AEON Mobile: 08:00 cutoff/23:00 issue timing, phone/store/web channels, non-cancellable issue request, unpaid/SIM-reissue blockers and one-stop behavior structured.
evidence_policy: No fixed issue time is invented where the current official source does not publish one.
MNP One-Stop and reservation-number flow remain separate.
Data-only/SMS-only contracts are not treated as MNP-eligible without explicit official support.
Static page content is changed only where Phase172 current evidence materially supersedes the older statement.
next_step: Phase173: currentize the next high-value legacy MNP cohort, prioritizing NifMo, OCN Mobile ONE, J:COM MOBILE, QTmobile, LinksMate, y.u mobile and LIBMO, while retaining provider-specific issue-time and blocker evidence.
